svg.title: Pixel MSE by image and method, on a log scale
svg.desc: Each row is one method, in the order ANNA, UFO, unregularised. Dots are individual seeds and the dark tick is the median. Cat: median ANNA 0.0139, UFO 0.0138, unregularised 0.0077. Butterfly: median ANNA 0.0045, UFO 0.0059, unregularised 0.0056. Skull: median ANNA 0.0024, UFO 0.0040, unregularised 0.0010.
